info.name: eQOURSE Backend API
info.description:
All REST API endpoints for the eQOURSE EdTech platform backend.

Base URL: {{base_url}}

Set the `base_url` variable to `http://localhost:5001/api` for local development.

For admin-protected routes, first call POST /auth/login to get a token, then set the `auth_token` collection variable.

variable.description: JWT token received after admin login

exec: console.log('✅ Token saved to collection variable auth_token');

request.description: Admin login. On success, the JWT is automatically saved to `auth_token` collection variable.
